items.definition:
a person who worships a god or religious figure
Many worshippers gathered at the temple for the ceremony.

a small, inexpensive restaurant
We had a lovely dinner at the new bistro downtown.

a ship or aircraft used for carrying cargo
The freighter was loaded with containers for its long voyage.

a sudden, involuntary contraction of the diaphragm and respiratory organs, causing a characteristic sound
I had a hiccup during my presentation.

lack of activity or movement
Prolonged inactivity can lead to health problems.

a large flightless bird
The ostrich is the largest living bird.

fog or haze intensified by smoke or other atmospheric pollutants
The city was covered in a thick layer of smog.

a device for sprinkling water
The garden sprinkler turned on automatically.

a tornado
The news reported a powerful twister heading towards the town.

the sport or exercise of lifting barbells or dumbbells
He trains for weightlifting competitions every day.

a marker used to keep one's place in a book; a saved link to a website
I used a bookmark to remember my page in the novel.

an area suitable for camping
We found a nice campground near the lake.

the central woody part of an ear of corn
We ate corn on the cob for dinner.

a large African antelope
We saw a herd of gnus migrating across the plains.

a desirable or attractive item; a self-righteous person
The children eagerly awaited the goody bags at the party.

a large open area of country covered with grass
Many wild animals roam freely across the vast grassland.

a cage for small animals; a storage cabinet
The rabbit lived happily in its hutch in the garden.

a pier or landing place for boats
We walked along the wooden jetty to watch the sunset.

a dull brownish-yellow color; a fabric of this color
He wore a pair of khaki trousers.

a spice from a tropical tree
She added a pinch of nutmeg to the sauce.

ruble (Russian currency)
The value of the Russian ruble has fluctuated recently.

saltwater (water containing salt)
Most of the Earth's water is saltwater, found in oceans and seas.

streamer (a long, narrow strip of material used for decoration or as a signal; a person who broadcasts live video content online)
Colorful streamers hung from the ceiling for the party.

streetcar (a public transport vehicle running on rails in the street)
We took the streetcar to get downtown and avoid traffic.

a door at the back of a building
Please use the backdoor when leaving the building.

a person with blonde hair
She was a natural blondie, with bright golden hair.

a person present but not involved
A bystander called the police after witnessing the accident.

small pieces of paper thrown at celebrations
The bride and groom were showered with confetti.

a piece cut from something; a news clipping
She took a rose cutting to plant in her garden.

the time in the morning when daylight first appears
We started our hike at daybreak to avoid the heat.

a machine or container that releases a measured amount of something
The soap dispenser in the bathroom is empty.

a fast-flying insect with a long body and two pairs of large wings
A colorful dragonfly landed on the lily pad.

the fastest pace of a horse or other quadruped
The horse broke into a full gallop across the field.

a cake or cookie flavored with ginger and molasses
We decorated gingerbread cookies for Christmas.

A young goose.
The mother goose led her goslings to the pond.

An insect that jumps and makes a chirping sound.
A grasshopper jumped high into the air.

A dish of pieces of meat, fish, or vegetables roasted or grilled on a skewer.
We ordered chicken kebabs for dinner.

the food, etc., necessary for health, growth, and good condition
Proper nourishment is vital for a child's development.

a symbol or word representing a number
The Roman numeral for ten is X.

a game in which players shoot capsules of paint at each other
They went paintballing last weekend.

a cue sport
He enjoys playing snooker with his friends on weekends.

a boat propelled by a steam engine
The old steamboat offered scenic tours along the river.

a cartoon character or animation
My favorite toon is Bugs Bunny.

a short, sharp sound made by a horn or whistle
The train gave a loud toot as it approached the crossing.

a person who makes and serves coffee drinks
The barista made me a perfect latte.

An act of hitting someone or something repeatedly; a defeat.
The team took a severe beating in the final game.

A short break from work or activity.
Let's take a five-minute breather before we continue.

A twilled cotton fabric, typically khaki-colored, used for trousers.
He wore a pair of comfortable chino trousers.

A condition in which feces are discharged from the bowels frequently and in a liquid form.
He suffered from severe diarrhoea after eating contaminated food.

a young deer; a light yellowish-brown color
We saw a small fawn grazing in the meadow.

a machine that plays selected musical recordings when money is inserted
We put some coins in the jukebox and played our favorite songs.

a one-piece garment combining trousers and a top
She wore a stylish blue jumpsuit to the party.

a light purplish-red color
The sunset painted the sky in shades of orange and magenta.

a dish of tortilla chips with melted cheese and other toppings
We ordered a large plate of nachos to share.

a track for racing, especially horses or cars
They spent the afternoon at the racetrack watching the horses.

please respond (used to request a reply to an invitation)
Please RSVP by the end of the week so we can get a headcount.

a shallow box or hollow in the ground containing sand for children to play in; a safe environment for experimentation
The children were playing happily in the sandbox.

a person whose trade is making or repairing shoes
The old shoemaker carefully repaired the worn-out boots.

the light from a candle or candles
They enjoyed a romantic dinner by candlelight.

flower seller
I bought a bouquet of roses from the florist.

a person who sells food
I bought fresh vegetables from the grocer.

a pause or break
We bought popcorn during the intermission.

a traditional telephone connection
Many homes no longer have a landline phone.

the flesh of sheep, especially mature sheep, used as food
The recipe called for tender mutton.
